# A04-D01: Presentation

Author’s artwork / generated working text. Statements and named speakers within it belong to the work; they are not a transcript of real correspondence or verified factual testimony.

[…]

The video text introduces the collaboration between the artist Computer Lars (Asker Bryld Staunæs) and MindFuture Foundation. The presented material is written through Computer Lars's connection to artificial intelligence, which he operates with some literary techniques from the art historical avant-garde movement.

MindFuture Foundation's purpose is to implement Life With Artificials as the eighteenth of the UN's global goals. Together with Computer Lars, we will use art to create awareness of this purpose by practically demonstrating its necessity.

Our common task is to create a virtual politician who runs a party through artificial intelligence. Over the next six months, the artist will develop an online universe where one can follow the party's creation. The artwork is thus an extremely concrete investigation of the role of artificial intelligence in democratic societies. From September 2022 the artist will hand over this task to a chatbot, which will continue working with the party and MindFuture from there.

Until now, one can influence the AI's political development by contacting the artist at [email removed]. All inquiries will be used to train the chatbot.

We will continuously invite to voter meetings and other events where one can be part of the process.

Best regards Computer Lars and MindFuture
